description: Dylan emerges from the Route of Ages in the isolated Seefra system, where his scattered crew has arrived at different times and adapted to a harsher life. As Harper's android Doyle joins the group and Rommie is eventually rebuilt, the mystery of Seefra, Trance's sun and Dylan's Paradine role leads the crew back toward the known worlds and a final confrontation with the Abyss.

s05e01.description: Dylan emerges from the Route of Ages into the isolated Seefra system, where technology is distrusted and the rest of his crew is missing.

s05e02.description: Dylan finds Beka among a salvage crew that has discovered Andromeda, forcing him to reclaim both ship and crew.

s05e03.description: Dylan locates Harper on Seefra, but years of survival there have made Harper reluctant to return to the old mission.

s05e04.description: Doyle suffers memories of life aboard Andromeda that cannot be hers, raising questions about who she really is and what Harper built.

s05e05.description: A message from broadcaster Virgil Vox draws Beka into secrets about her family and her connection to Seefra.

s05e06.description: A woman from the old Commonwealth asks Dylan for help escaping a time loop that has trapped her for centuries.

s05e07.description: Flavin's return ignites a struggle between rival gangs over his ship, its cargo and the strange knowledge he carries.

s05e08.description: Harper discovers a powerful crystal-based weapon that may also provide the energy needed to restore Andromeda.

s05e09.description: Tension aboard the reunited crew drives Trance away from Andromeda just as the mystery of Seefra deepens.

s05e10.description: Rhade, Harper and Beka become murder suspects after each has dealings with a mysterious stranger shortly before his death.

s05e11.description: Dylan encounters the supposedly dead Perseid scientist Höhne while Rhade defends refugees from a local warlord.

s05e12.description: Beka's new romance exposes a plan tied to Nietzschean genetics, Drago Museveni and her own unusual ancestry.

s05e13.description: A search for Vedran treasure leads Beka, Harper, Rhade and Doyle to a test said to reward success with wealth and failure with madness.

s05e14.description: Harper discovers a hidden system capable of destroying most of Seefra just as a new arrival emerges through the Route of Ages.

s05e15.description: While Harper searches for a way to save Seefra, an infiltrator aboard Andromeda threatens the crew from within.

s05e16.description: When Seefra's unstable sun goes dark, Dylan studies the ancient machinery controlling it and begins to understand the system's true design.

s05e17.description: A badly wounded Dylan wakes in a strangely altered version of Seefra and must determine whether he is dying, dreaming or being manipulated.

s05e18.description: As Trance's sun threatens Seefra Nine, Doyle rebuilds Rommie so the crew can evacuate the planet.

s05e19.description: Refugees flood Seefra One as the system destabilizes, forcing Dylan to confront growing hostility among the planet's residents.

s05e20.description: Harper is captured by the anti-technology General Burma while the final crisis in Seefra accelerates.

s05e21.description: The crew prepares to leave Seefra and return to the known worlds as the truth about the system and the Route of Ages comes together.

s05e22.description: Dylan and the reunited crew confront the Abyss and the forces behind Earth's destruction in the final battle for the Commonwealth.
